proper_scores.conventions: Probabilities are host-renormalized from frozen candidate next-token log probabilities. Binary Brier is mean squared error; multiclass Brier is sum over classes then mean; log scores use natural logarithms; no numerical floor; conditional relation is scored only when human truth says evidence is sufficient.

cross_corpus_interpretation: KCC V-2 and CI-6 independently repeat MULTI_FACET_OVERALIGNMENT: both frozen PARTIALLY_ALIGNED cases were predicted ALIGNED with near-unit conditional probability.
KCC S-2 repeats a conservative evidence-sufficiency undercall under the same output-scope qualification that made Verisk S-2 contract-sensitive.
All six KCC adverse controls passed, so this test did not produce reviewer-only sufficiency, future-tense completion, copied-requirement sufficiency, or revision-history wrong-scope overclaim.
limitations: No CONFLICT primary case occurred, so conflict discrimination remains untested.

Candidate-renormalized next-token probabilities are conditional scores under the frozen prompt, label order, verbalizers, tokenizer, and decoding configuration; they do not establish global calibration.
